description:
FREE. Guesses which spoken Arabic dialect a text is written in (Moroccan, Algerian, Tunisian, Libyan, Egyptian, Sudanese, Levantine, Iraqi, Gulf, Yemeni), in Arabic script or Arabizi. Use it to pick the right "dialect" for the translation tools.

Pricing: free, no API key needed.
name: detect_arabic_dialect
title: Detect Arabic dialect
